response.query: Which concrete equity measures (device/internet provision, translations, low-literacy content) and engagement metrics by SES/race will be implemented and reported to detect differential access or outcomes?
response.answer: Concrete equity measures include internet provision and low-literacy content; engagement metrics by SES/race will track differential access and outcomes. These are essential for detecting disparities.
